description: B3 (Avital Zak) <-> P2 (Mali Chasai) Week 4 CONNECT contract: the minimum producer-consumer freeze agreed on between them. Named fixture: the single real committed lot lot-kestenbaum-54554-121421 from P1's fixtures/auction-data/lots.json, embedded once below (shared by every scenario) so this fixture does not depend on the size of P1's dataset. For each scenario, B3 builds `expectedRequest` from `criteria` via criteriaToSearchRequest() and sends it to P2's LotsService.search(); P2 is expected to return the shared `expectedResponse` for that lot in every case. `canonical-english-category` sends the plain canonical token; `hebrew-category-alias` sends the same category as a Hebrew alias to prove P2's Add Hebrew/English aliases and connect B3 checkpoint resolves it to the same lot, not just a direct token match. Creators are sent as `filters.creators` (agreed with P2), not in `query`; P2 resolves creator names to canonical tokens. Known limitation, documented not hidden: the named lot carries no `creator` value and P2 ANDs every filter together, so a creator filter excludes it until P1 populates the field.
